Federated Investors Inc increased its stake in Ca Inc (CA) by 58.67% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Federated Investors Inc bought 133,700 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.27% with the market. The institutional investor held 361,586 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $12.03M, up from 227,886 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Federated Investors Inc who had been investing in Ca Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $14.79B market cap company. The stock increased 0.94% or $0.33 during the last trading session, reaching $35.5. About 1.58M shares traded. CA, Inc. (NASDAQ:CA) has risen 5.46% since May 22, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 6.09% the S&P500.
